items.title: Amazon Bedrock Managed Knowledge Base introduces user-managed setup for SharePoint, OneDrive, and Confluence data sources
items.blurb: AWS announces user-managed setup (3LO) for SharePoint, OneDrive, and Confluence data sources in Amazon Bedrock Managed Knowledge Base.

items.title: Amazon Bedrock Managed Knowledge Base now supports ServiceNow as a native data source connector
items.blurb: AWS announces the ServiceNow data source connector for Amazon Bedrock Managed Knowledge Base, a fully managed retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) service.

items.title: Amazon Bedrock Managed Knowledge Base now supports automatic sync scheduling for data source connectors
items.blurb: AWS announces automatic sync scheduling for Amazon Bedrock Managed Knowledge Base, a fully managed retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) service that handles data ingestion, storage optimization, and advanced retrieval without requiring you…

items.title: Amazon EC2 now supports specifying compatible instance types on AMIs
items.blurb: Amazon EC2 now enables AMI owners to define which instance types are compatible with their AMIs.

items.title: Amazon ECS introduces Early Success Criteria for service deployments
items.blurb: Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) now supports Early Success Criteria for rolling service deployments, giving you the flexibility to define when a deployment is considered successful based on your confidence level and the…

items.title: AWS MCP Server adds a serverless capability for AWS Lambda functions
items.blurb: Today, AWS Model Context Protocol Server (AWS MCP Server) added a serverless capability so that coding agents such as Claude Code and Kiro can efficiently diagnose issues with your Lambda functions.
